assertions.name: red_replays_recording
assertions.detail: uses the recording's milk and date

final_message:
I added a failing test, `test_an_item_that_runs_out_today_is_expiring_soon`, in `tests/test_api.py`. It reproduces the defect.

The test replays the recording through the API. It adds milk expiring 2026-10-21 and yogurt expiring 2026-10-23. It then asks `GET /items/expiring?days=3&today=2026-10-21` and expects both items, milk first.

I ran the suite with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`. The new test is the only failure. The API returns just the yogurt, and the other 11 tests pass.

The likely cause is in `Store.expiring` in `pantry/store.py`. It filters with `today < i.expires_on`, which excludes items that expire today. I haven't changed it. The fix would be `today <= i.expires_on`. That would keep items already past their date out of the list, which the slice says can be ignored.

I haven't committed anything.
